Experience a faster, smarter, and more secure way to access your home — no keys or phone required. The LA44 comes equipped with a built-in camera, LCD screen, and integrated Wi-Fi + Bluetooth, combining cutting-edge convenience and technology in one sleek design. You can unlock your door in 8 different ways: Face Unlock, Fingerprint, Wi-Fi (via mobile app), Bluetooth, OTP, PIN Code, RFID Card, and Manual Key. Designed exclusively for wooden doors (minimum thickness: 38mm), the lock supports up to 100 users, making it ideal for families or shared spaces. The LAVNA Smart Life mobile app lets you add or remove fingerprints, PINs, and cards, manage access settings, and view the unlock history to track who entered and when. One of LA44’s standout features is its smart camera with doorbell function. When someone presses the doorbell icon, their photo instantly appears on your phone, allowing you to see and unlock remotely — anytime, anywhere. Simultaneously, the indoor LCD screen displays a live video feed, so you can view the visitor in real time and decide whether to open the door. With built-in Wi-Fi + Bluetooth, the setup is quick and hassle-free, unlike traditional locks that require complex configurations. The LA44 is universal in design, suitable for both left and right-hand doors, and can be used for indoor or outdoor installation. In case the battery is completely drained, you can still unlock your door using the manual key, or connect a power bank externally to power up the lock and unlock via your registered fingerprint or mobile app. For emergencies, we recommend keeping a spare manual key with your car or office keys.
